column3: 首都下にある永久地下牢に来た
column4: They came to the permanent underground prison beneath the capital.

column3: カオス、カミーラに勝てたのは運がよかったからだ、解放してはならんぞ。
column4: Chaos says: We were lucky to have defeated Camilla; she must not be released.

column3: それより殺せ、さっさと殺せ、あれは危険だ
column4: More than that, kill her-kill her quickly. She's dangerous.

column3: がははは、あれはあれで可愛い女だ　と余裕のランス
column4: Hahaha, she's a cute woman in her own way, says a relaxed Rance.

column3: ただ、この永久地下牢は魔王大国ゼスが作った最大級の封印施設でもあるので
column4: However, this permanent underground prison is also one of the largest sealing facilities built by the Demon King nation, Zeth.

column3: なかなか突破するのは疲れるぞ。ま、カミーラちゃんに会う為ならがんばろうー
column4: It's quite exhausting to break through. Well, if it's to meet Camilla-chan, I'll do my best.

column3: 他の者も止めるが聞かない
column4: Others try to stop me, but I don't listen.
